audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics are wrong in eight places. (a) Blinding Assault is called a blind that 'negates your entire kit temporarily' and blinds your follow-up. (b) Vault is described as a knockback that shoves Sion away, and the trade advice tells you to hit her 'airborne' because 'she cannot dodge it'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Blinding Assault marks an enemy and HINDERS ITS VISION — it obscures what you can see, it does not stop your abilities from working. Vault (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 675 range) dashes her TO you, briefly interrupts you, and lands HER near max attack range away — you are not displaced, you are interrupted, and she gets the spacing. The airborne-can't-dodge line is not in Riot's description at all.
audit.corrected: Blind replaced with vision-hinder everywhere it drove advice; Vault restated as an interrupt that resets her spacing, and the commit window keyed to Vault being spent (12s at rank 1) rather than to her being mid-air.
sources: enemyKit Q and E Riot text

audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8 — 12 at rank 1, which is the timer your entire commit window is measured against. Blinding Assault is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 at 1025 range; Heightened Senses is 50s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 12s at rank 1 written into breakdown.cooldowns, whys[1], phases[1].why, spikes[0], early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere said Behind Enemy Lines can be cancelled.
audit.why: It is a channel — a landed Decimating Smash or an Unstoppable Onslaught collision cancels it outright, which is the difference between a free Quinn roam and a dead Quinn.

edits.before: Quinn owns this stretch entirely. Her Harrier passive gives her a speed burst on every auto, letting her poke and backpedal before your Q charge completes. Do not attempt a charged Q in the open — she reads the telegraph, presses Vault, and you eat a knockback into a blind while she repositions with fresh Harrier stacks. Farm with the tip of your Q, W-shield her trades and detonate the shield for chip damage back, and accept that your only objective here is zero deaths and maximum HP passive stacks from last-hits.

edits.before: At levels 4 through 6 Quinn can roam with her R and you cannot follow — call it to your team immediately and shove the wave to deny plates every time she leaves. If she stays, continue the same pattern: W-shield absorbs her poke, charge Q only from brush cover where she cannot see the telegraph. The one window you own is the instant her Vault lands — she is airborne and cannot dodge. Land the full charged Q knockup, E armor-shred, and brawl. Outside that window, farm and stack.
edits.after: At levels 4 through 6 Quinn roams with her R — call it to your team and shove the wave to deny plates every time she leaves. Behind Enemy Lines is a channel: a landed Decimating Smash or an Unstoppable Onslaught collision cancels it outright, so a Quinn taking off beside you is a free interrupt. If she stays, W-shield absorbs her poke and you charge Q only from brush cover. The window you own is a spent Vault, 12 seconds at rank 1 — land the full knockup, E armour-shred, and brawl.
